top_signals.title: A Gold Relief Rally on the Horizon?
top_signals.summary: Is gold's latest bounce a real opportunity or just another bear market trap? Carley Garner, DeCarley Trading Senior Commodity Strategist and Broker, joins Bloomberg Open Interest to bread down why seasonal trends, falling crude oil, and Treasury correlations could fuel a short‑term gold rally, even as she stays bearish long term. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp. today issued updates to plug at least 974 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, by far its biggest single patch batch ever. Microsoft says artificial intelligence is helping to speed the discovery of vulnerabilities, but security experts warn that many organizations already are struggling to prioritize the more human-intensive endeavor of testing and deploying so many fixes each month.

Citi Makes It Easier for Junior Bankers to Advance
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc. will now advance some investment banking analysts to associates in two years instead of three. The move gives bankers a faster path to more responsibility and higher pay, while the bank gets to keep top talent. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: EU Electric Vehicle Sales Hit Record as Fuel Prices Surge
top_signals.summary: Record-high fuel prices and a record number of newly available affordable models have pushed electric vehicle sales in the European Union to an all-time high this year, Transport & Environment, a European advocacy group for clean transport and energy, said in a report on Monday. Between January and August, sales of battery electric vehicles (BEVs) soared by 45% from a year earlier to as many as 1.64 million units across the EU. top_signals.title: Batavia Vessel Transported Successfully to Lelystad
top_signals.summary: Wooden sailing vessel Batavia was successfully transported to and installed at its final resting place in Lelystad on Oct 2. The 1995-delivered, full-scale reconstruction of the 1628 Dutch East India Company ship had been prepared for its final voyage at Damen Shiprepair Amsterdam.

top_signals.title: Who’s Tracking You? Use This New Service to Find Out
top_signals.summary: It can be daunting to determine who's responsible for showing ads on the websites we visit, or who's harvesting data from the mobile apps we use every day. That information is already semi-public, but it is not easily parsed and traditionally much of it has remained walled away in the hands of large advertising platforms. Not anymore: A powerful and free new service called DecryptAds scrapes and correlates this adtech data and makes it simple to quickly learn a great deal about the entities that are tracking you.
